question: What makes players come back every day (streaks, daily challenge, rewards, reminders), what do they resent about those mechanics, and what should Trubbo (voice quiz) adopt? Plus: what do the 'Road Trip Trivia' style car apps do and what do their users say?
keywords: come back|coming back|keeps? me (coming|going|motivated|engaged)|look forward|part of my (day|morning|routine)|my (morning|daily|nightly) routine|\bhabit

codebook.streak_motivates: says a streak / day counter keeps them coming back, or is proud of it
codebook.streak_lost_upset: lost a streak through their own miss (illness, travel, forgot) and is upset, demotivated or quit
codebook.streak_bug_lost: streak lost or reset because of a bug, sync, timezone or update
codebook.streak_pressure: streak causes anxiety, guilt or obligation; does the bare minimum only to keep it
codebook.streak_meaningless: says the streak is fake or pointless (freezes inflate it, streak is not real progress)
codebook.forgiveness_wanted: asks for or praises a streak freeze, repair, vacation mode, rest days or weekly goal
codebook.pay_to_keep: resents paying (money or premium currency) to repair/keep a streak or progress
codebook.daily_content_loved: returns for fresh daily content (daily puzzle, quiz, challenge, question); part of a routine
codebook.daily_limit_liked: likes that it is short or limited to once a day
codebook.daily_limit_resented: resents once-a-day limit or wait timers; wants more plays or an archive
codebook.reward_liked: enjoys rewards, badges, achievements, collectibles, XP, levels, unlocks
codebook.reward_empty_or_rigged: rewards are useless, nothing to spend coins on, rigged spins, or rewards were cut
codebook.energy_lives_resented: hearts / energy / lives limit how much they can play
codebook.ads_for_rewards: too many or forced ads, including watch-an-ad-for-reward
codebook.leaderboard_pressure: leagues or leaderboards stress them, cheaters, wants to opt out
codebook.social_motivates: playing or comparing with friends/family, shared streaks, sharing results motivates
codebook.notif_annoying: too many, guilt-tripping or unstoppable notifications
codebook.widget: mentions a home-screen or lock-screen widget (praise or request or bug)
codebook.progress_real: motivated by real progress, learning or good content rather than game mechanics; or says gamification got in the way of it
codebook.car_context: plays or wants to play in the car / commute / road trip, or describes road-trip games (put what they play or want in `theme`)
codebook.voice_audio: comments on voice, audio, read-aloud or hands-free use (quality, wish, bug)
codebook.other: about daily return, rewards or car play but none of the above (describe in `quote`)
